standard_rules: Use structured JSON rather than prose.
Start with a readable physical action or conflict in the first frame.
Use one physical event per 0.6-1.2 second beat; no beat longer than 1.5 seconds.
Let props and character action create motion; camera only reinforces existing action.
Introduce props through action, keep continuity, and reuse a key prop in the payoff or loop.
Keep Russian speech verbatim in line fields and all production descriptions in English.
Change exactly one material experiment variable; keep the remaining production parameters stable.
Run Critic before generation and allow at most three material correction iterations after a technically usable render.
failed_patterns: Long establishing shots before the action.
Camera movement used as a substitute for physical events.
Static beats without character or physically interacting secondary action.
Treating one successful video as a confirmed audience rule.
promotion_note: TikTok audience rules remain UNKNOWN until independent experiments with sufficient samples are available.
